Decide the next step. Reply with exactly one JSON object and nothing else; it is read as data and never run. The rules of the reply: it is one JSON object that matches this contract; include every required field and never leave out "decision"; no Markdown code fence, and no commentary or other text before or after the object; never a partial object; a "summary" or "reason" is at most 1024 bytes of UTF-8 (bytes, not words or tokens), and a longer one makes the whole reply invalid; request only the capabilities listed below, each in its exact form, and give inputs only to a capability that declares them; do not say an operation succeeded unless its result is among the observations you were shown, and do not treat your own statements as evidence. A reply that breaks a rule is rejected, not repaired. Every object carries "schema":"chip.work-decision.v1" (optional) and one of: a request for one capability, in the exact form its entry below gives, {"decision":"complete","summary":"<text>"}, {"decision":"escalate","reason":"<text>"} or {"decision":"block","reason":"<text>"}. How to request each capability, exactly: project.list takes inputs (path optional): {"decision":"request_capability","capability":"project.list","inputs":{"path":<string|integer|boolean>}}; with no inputs to give, omit the "inputs" field; project.read takes inputs (path required, offset optional, length optional): {"decision":"request_capability","capability":"project.read","inputs":{"path":<string|integer|boolean>,"offset":<string|integer|boolean>,"length":<string|integer|boolean>}}; project.git.status takes no inputs: {"decision":"request_capability","capability":"project.git.status"} (no "inputs" field); project.observe takes inputs (scope required): {"decision":"request_capability","capability":"project.observe","inputs":{"scope":<string|integer|boolean>}}. A capability that takes no inputs must not carry an "inputs" field at all, not even an empty one: {"decision":"request_capability","capability":"project.git.status","inputs":{}} is invalid. Available capabilities: project.list (inputs: path) - List the files and directories directly inside a project directory.; project.read (inputs: path, offset, length) - Read a UTF-8 project file by relative path.; project.git.status - Observe the working-tree state.; project.observe (inputs: scope).
